# Jon Barron personal website template

Source: https://github.com/jonbarron/jonbarron.github.io

Revision: `25905bd773bd778585e66725780a7bc589269af1`

Retrieved: 2026-10-08

The upstream README states: “Feel free to clone this code for your own personal use.”

`jon-barron.html` is adapted directly from the upstream document, 800px table layout, profile table, research heading table, and publication row. Personal content and additional sections have been substituted. Source attribution is retained in this file and the HTML source comment; the visible footer credit was removed at the user's request.

`stylesheet.css` is the upstream stylesheet; only the eight Google Fonts URLs have been replaced with local paths. Lato font files are distributed with their license in `fonts/OFL.txt`.

`jon-barron-overrides.css` contains local additions for the user's education, honors, robotics project, and mobile layout. The upstream site’s personal details, publications, analytics, and CNAME are not included.
